scope.description: What every package name starts with, up to the domain name: '@scope/' or '@scope/product-'. Inferred from the existing packages when omitted.

prefix.description: The selector prefix of the workspace's components. Inferred from an app's angular.json when omitted.

packages.description: The folder holding the domain packages.

libs.description: The folder holding the simple libraries.

skipInstall.description: Do not run the package manager after adding Sheriff.
